name: v0.8.5
body:
## What's Changed
* docs: re-record the graph-effects demo (share-ready) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/130
* site: refresh the release snapshot to v0.8.4 by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/131
* docs: refresh graph screenshots + layout notes after the spacing change by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/138
* feat(settings): adjustable graph effect intensity (#137) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/139
* feat(ui): play the delete burn outside Graph mode (#135) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/140
* fix(graph): pack a cooled dense layout so cards never overlap (#136) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/141
* test(ui): bound the external-create waits in wall time by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/143
* fix(graph): stop dense layouts that cycle instead of settling (#144) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/145
* Release 0.8.5: bump version and changelog by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/146


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/compare/v0.8.4...v0.8.5
